title: Rick Reed - WhatsApp: Half a billion unsuspecting FreeBSD users
summary: Rick Reed of WhatsApp speaks at MeetBSD about running a messaging service on FreeBSD and Erlang at huge scale. He covers the stack, tuning and the challenges of millions of connections per host.
why: Pointed to as a rare look at how a tiny engineering team ran WhatsApp's massive scale on FreeBSD and Erlang.

quote.text: Their technology stack (FreeBSD/Erlang) is pretty interesting, more info here: 2014 talks by Rick Reed
